image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a rooster (cock) standing on grass. The bird features vibrant plumage with golden-orange hackle feathers, reddish-brown body feathers, and dark green/black tail feathers. It has a prominent red comb and wattles, a yellow beak, and visible scaled legs with spurs. The background consists of green grass and some soil.
